title: Symptom-Free Streak Counter
dataSources: Posture readings (`posture:reading`), symptom logs (`symptom:log`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), sneeze events (`sneeze:event`).
app: Everyday body-signal logs — posture sensors, symptom and allergy journals, hydration-linked bathroom logs, and quirky personal counters — sent to Splunk HEC via wearables, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=symptom:log
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as symptoms by _time
| eval symptom_day=if(symptoms>0,1,0), symptom_free=if(symptom_day=0,1,0)
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(symptom_free=1,1,0))) as clear_streak reset_after="(symptom_day=1)"
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how many symptom-free days in a row you are managing.
value: Seeing a clear streak can be motivating and can also reveal whether an intervention is quietly working.
implementation: Aggregate symptom events into daily buckets; maintain a symptom-free streak counter in Splunk.
visualization: Daily streak chart of symptom-free days.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how many symptom-free days you manage in a row, which helps good periods feel real and measurable.
